base_definition: No fixed base constraint; the four robots maintain a moving connected network
radio_definition: 10m distance-gated simulated communication links, requested by user; not measured RF
budget_definition: Unmeasured distance proxy set to 1000m per robot to avoid a 100m demo cap truncating whole-map exploration
completion_definition: No unknown potentially accessible cells remain within the mission bounds, and no reachable frontier remains; map-based estimate only
shadow_definition: Simulator terrain oracle; triangle projections onto z=0.02 with footprint and angular margins; elevated terrain excluded conservatively
